comparison.objective: Post a wet-floor sign before wiping a spill.
comparison.physical_skill: Order-sensitive sign placement and sponge wiping across a tracked area.
comparison.success_condition: Sign must be upright 6–20 cm from the spill before sponge contact; early wiping permanently fails; coverage determines credit. No spec version is present.
comparison.reason: This is safety sequencing and wiping, unrelated to mechanical adjustment and response-based tuning.
